Ava (Design): Quick design check — toast behavior when a modal closes. Saw inconsistent screen‑reader announcements + focus jumping in a couple of apps. Repro attached. Marcus (Frontend): Repro steps: Dashboard toolbar -> open modal -> save -> modal closes -> toast appears bottom-right but keyboard focus stays on previous button. NVDA sometimes doesn't announce the toast. Neha (a11y): We shouldn't steal focus for success toasts usually. Options: 1) aria-live region (polite) so SRs announce, 2) move focus for errors only. Example: `
Saved
` Olivia (Product): Prefer not to move focus for success flows — customers expect their place to remain. Could we add `aria-describedby` on the element that retains focus pointing to the toast id instead of focus shift? Liam (Engine): `aria-describedby` is doable. Implementation note: toast container currently reuses a single id which breaks `aria-describedby` uniqueness. We'll need unique ids per toast (eg. `toast-`). Also noticed compact spacing token tweak reduced toolbar left/right padding — hit targets feel tight in compact mode. Sam (Design): Copy nit: prefer short, scannable copy — use "Saved" vs "Save successful". For dismiss control, what about "Dismiss notification" vs just "Close"? Longer label helps screen‑reader context but clutters visually. :thinking_face: Marcus (Frontend): Proposal: keep visual focus where it is for success messages, add a visually-hidden role=status region per toast with `aria-live=polite` for non-critical messages and `aria-live=assertive` for errors. Ensure each toast has a unique id and expose an option to attach that id via `aria-describedby` to the focused element. Also adding `data-prevent-focus-loss` on modals that should preserve focus during internal toasts. Code sketch: ``` const id = `toast-${Date.now()}`; render(`
Saved
`); // optionally: focusedEl.setAttribute('aria-describedby', id); ``` Neha (a11y): One more nit: when modal submission fails, shift focus to first invalid field *and* announce the error assertively. Success vs error semantics need clear split. Olivia (Product): Agreed. Also on the spacing token — compact mode reduced toolbar icon padding from 12px to 6px; can we enforce min padding of 8px so hit targets aren't < 44px? That would satisfy both density and accessibility. Sam (Design): I'll update the token map and run a quick Figma micro‑test for compact vs regular toolbar. Posting mock in #design-assets in 30m. deploy-bot: New PR opened: frontend#2345 — toasts: unique ids + aria region + aria-describedby hook. Liam (Engine): Thanks, Marcus. Quick QA note: JAWS users sometimes get double announcements when both role=status and aria-live are used; we'll test combinations (role=status only vs aria-live attr). Marcus (Frontend): I'll iterate on the PR after Sam's token update (so spacing changes don't regress toolbar layout). ETA: tomorrow morning. cc @Neha (a11y) for review. :thumbsup:
